findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done — A scored `fix now` finding passes a P0-only light review and is recorded in `known` as `lived with`, but `_settled` recognizes earlier below-bar findings only when `score.bar` returns `follow-up` or `live with`. The later review's `$accepted` block is built from `_settled`, so it omits this finding. If the same item is reviewed again after sign-off, a repeat with the same file and title is neither presented as accepted nor automatically ignored, and can hold work under the full review gate.
